title: 3 ex-drug convicts arrested in Lucena buy-busts on All Saints’ Day

blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — Three ex-drug convicts were arrested in separate anti-narcotics operations in Lucena City on Sunday, Nov. 1, during the observance of All Saints’ Day, police said. Two of the suspects were arrested at 2:25 p.m. after they allegedly sold shabu (crystal meth) to an undercover police officer in Barangay Ibabang Iyam, according to Lucena City police director Lt. Col. Ryan Hernandez in a report on Nov. 2. Authorities seized three heat-sealed plastic sachets of suspected shabu worth P73,440 from the suspects.
